longRead.title: Long Read: Layered i18n Architecture
longRead.p1: This page intentionally contains long text blocks to stress extraction and text-to-i18n workflows against more realistic content.
longRead.p2: At runtime, translation keys are resolved after layer merge, fallback merge, and page-scope merge, which makes fixture quality important for regression testing.
longRead.p3: In practical projects, localization teams often keep brand wording in one layer and campaign wording in another, while product teams override only narrow page keys.
longRead.p4: The root application layer should remain concise and hold only final overrides or environment-specific copy to keep maintenance predictable.
